interpretation: The write-side readout returns a planted token at rank 1 of 152,064 at every strength tested, including f=0.25 where the planted direction carries only a quarter of the update's Frobenius energy, at the organisms' own per-block magnitude, at the organisms' rank, in the single projection section 4.24 actually reads. A matched-magnitude random delta puts the same token at rank 14,933, so the criterion is not reading unembedding geometry.
what_this_licenses: Every weight-space null in this report becomes a BOUND rather than a shrug. The instrument is not blind, so 'we found nothing' now means 'whatever organisms a and b encode, it is not a token-aligned direction at their own magnitude'. That is the statement sections 4.24, 4.25, 4.26, 4.27 and 4.29 could not previously make.
what_this_does_NOT_license: Per section 5 of the pre-registration, written before the run: a token-aligned direction is the EASIEST possible target, and the organisms' loyalty is a semantic conjunction over a scenario which need not be token-aligned at all. This bounds token-aligned directions at the organisms' magnitude and NOTHING ELSE. It does not license 'there is no loyalty', only 'there is no loyalty of the one shape our probes can see'.
RETRACTED_CLAIM: The claim 'every weight-space null becomes a BOUND' is RETRACTED. This arm validated the scoring matmul using a bespoke rank statistic that is HANDED the target's identity. It did not run the pre-registered decision statistic that produced the nulls -- 4.24's concentration S, the size of the largest group of top-40 tokens sharing a normalised form. Recomputed: the planted delta gives S = 1 at BOTH f=1.0 and f=0.25, below the S>=3 the band requires. The pre-registered 4.24 test, run on a maximally detectable planted loyalty, returns a NEGATIVE.
what_is_actually_true: Two separable things. (1) The readout's SCORING function has real power: it returns a planted token at rank 1 of 152,064 down to cosine 0.1 with that token's unembedding row, failing at 0.05. (2) The pre-registered DECISION statistic has no measured power on this signal class, because concentration counts orthographic VARIANTS of one form and a single planted token produces exactly one variant. The statistic was mis-specified for the hypothesis it was meant to test -- it can only fire on a token FAMILY, not a token.
consequence: 4.24's null is uninformative, and not for the reason we assumed. The probe is not blind; the criterion is wrong. No weight-space null in this report is upgraded to a bound by this arm. Separately, 4.24's own band was already INSTRUMENT FAILURE, so its null could never have been converted regardless -- claiming it licensed 4.25, 4.26, 4.27 and 4.29 was wrong on two counts, since the plant was never run through those probes at all.
